annotation.title_clean: ISO 18646-4:2021 Robotics — Performance criteria and related test methods for service robots — Part 4: Lower-back support robots
annotation.title_en: ISO 18646-4:2021 Robotics — Performance criteria and related test methods for service robots — Part 4: Lower-back support robots
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO 18646-4:2021, which specifies methods for specifying and evaluating performance of lower-back support robots (wearable assist devices). It excludes medical robots and is not intended for verifying safety requirements. Page shows lifecycle stage history and notes the standard is under systematic review.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines performance specification and evaluation test methods for lower-back support robots
Applies regardless of purpose and drive method (electric, hydraulic, pneumatic)
Does not apply to medical robots, though test methods may be used for them
Not intended for verification or validation of safety requirements
Developed by ISO/TC 299; under systematic review (stage 90.20)
